212

Regular meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas November 06, 1882.
Hon W A Saylor Mayor Presiding

Roll call present Alderman Kinney, schutze Bruggerhoff, Radekey Wilson

Absent alderman Burpritz, Thoreen, Metz
Cook

On motion of Alderman Bruggerhoff the
Council was called and the marshal sent after the absentees Alderman Metz came in and
answered to his name

On motion of alderman Bruggerhoff the
Call of the Council was suspended.

Reading of the minutes of the [illegible] of the Called meeting of Oct 31, 1882 postponed

On motion of Alderman Kinney the receiving of petitions was postponed until next meeting.
The reports of the city officers for the fiscal year ending Oct 31, 1882 received and
referred to the respective committees to which they belong. Report of the City Treasurer
assessor and Collector. City Clerk for the fiscal year and for the Qr. ending Oct 31, 1882
referred to the Finance Committee Report of the City Sexton for the year and month of Oct
1882 referred to the Cemetery Committee Report of the City Physician referred to the
Charity Committee Report of the Fire Department for the fiscal year ending Oct 31st 1882.
Referred to the fir Committee Report of the health inspector referred to the street
committee Report of Ben Thompson for the year ending Oct 20 1882 and for the month of Oct
to Oct 20th 1882 referred to the Police Committee Report of John O’Donnell City Marshal
from Oct 20 to Nov 1 1882 referred to the Police committee

On motion the Council adjourned

Read and approved Nov 20th 1882 F L Purnell Nov 20
City Clerk
